title: Jonathan Blow: Game design: the medium is the message
summary: Jonathan Blow's CreativeMornings talk arguing that business models shape game design, drawing an analogy between 1970s TV and HBO and between free-to-play and premium games. He calls for games that inspire awe rather than chase constraints.
why: HN cites it repeatedly in debates about in-app purchases and monetization corrupting games.

quote.text: how the business model deeply corrupts the game through the metaphor of bad 70's TV shows vs HBO
